name: Primotec
summary: Primotec Group Ltd operates as a consumer goods enterprise, manufacturing, importing, and distributing an extensive portfolio of items across Israel and Europe. Its diverse range of products includes sanitation supplies, paper-based goods, plastic products, single-use items, fragrances, domestic equipment, specialized medical and eldercare apparatus, and various packaging solutions. The company also provides fixtures and furniture designed for sanitary environments. Established in 1985, Primotec Group Ltd's main offices are located in Beersheba, Israel.
